easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
The Thing triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
